prompt: Create a high-resolution 2048x2048 four-view reference sheet for one D&D Dretch demon tabletop miniature. Same full-body creature and hunched combat-ready pose in every panel. Unarmed, no clothing, no wings or effects. Simple clean design and distinct silhouette. Painted realistic miniature style. White background, no base, no text or labels. Four equal square panels: top left FRONT, top right BACK, bottom left LEFT SIDE, bottom right RIGHT SIDE. Orthographic views, complete creature with margins, same scale and pose across all four views.
